SHOCKING NEW STUDY: Drinking Morning Coffee TRIPLES Your Risk of Sudden Death

By Viral Health Alert

A terrifying new epidemiological analysis has sent shockwaves through the medical community by proving that drinking a single cup of coffee in the morning triples your lifetime mortality risk.

Researchers observed that in a group of 100,000 coffee drinkers, 3 individuals experienced an ultra-rare cardiac arrhythmia event, compared to 1 individual in a control group of 100,000 non-drinkers. This proves a staggering 200% surge in fatal mortality caused directly by caffeine intake.

Doctors are now advising that all citizens immediately cease drinking coffee, tea, and warm beverages to avoid this catastrophic 300% mortality hazard.
